about.heading: A company founded on a wish
about.lead: Global Wish was founded in 2018 to stand beside people who seek happiness culturally, artistically and economically — beyond differences of language, race and nationality.

philosophy.title: Understanding across borders
philosophy.text: We deepen understanding of different values across every language, race and nation, create new values together, and support people who seek happiness culturally, artistically and economically.

philosophy.title: Innovation and conviction
philosophy.text: In fields that constantly demand fresh, flexible thinking, we never stand still — we remain a company that holds on to innovation and conviction.

philosophy.title: The environment comes first
philosophy.text: We recognise the preservation of the global environment as our most important issue.

philosophy.title: Responsibility in everything we do
philosophy.text: In every aspect of our business, we give top priority to preserving a healthy environment.

message: In the twenty-first century, disasters and conflicts continue around the world, and economic, political, environmental and racial problems are piling up.
Everyone hopes that human wisdom will resolve at least some of these tangled problems — and we cannot help but hope so too.
We founded Global Wish with the hope of helping such wishes come true around the world, and of standing beside people who keep walking steadily towards the future.
Through networks that connect Japan with the world, and communication that connects people with people, we want to be of service in any way we can.

Through translation and interpretation, international cultural exchange, art and music, lectures and education, we will stand beside you — understanding our differences, and creating and sharing new values together.

categories.title: Raw honey from the Siberian Altai
text: The Altai region lies in southern Siberia, a land of vast mountains and clear rivers often called the Earth's "green pharmacy" and its "lungs". It is one of the cleanest regions in Russia and renowned worldwide for its honey.
All our Altai honeys are raw: unheated and free of additives.

items.name: Meadowgrass honey
items.text: A true multi-flower honey from chicory, willow, fireweed, dandelion, meadowsweet, clover, sunflower and more. Its taste changes subtly with each year's flowers and weather — lovely in hot milk.

items.name: Mountain honey
items.text: Gathered from flowers blooming at 2,200 m, where bees store rich honey in the short summer. Mild yet full-bodied, with notes of maral root, acacia and hawthorn.

items.name: Taiga honey
items.text: From the coniferous forests of Siberia. Deep in colour, aromatic, with angelica, goldenrod, fireweed and wild strawberry. Wonderful with fresh cheese.

items.name: Clover honey
items.text: From yellow sweet clover. Clean, refreshing sweetness — perfect on toast and in cooking or fruit liqueurs.

items.name: Esparcet (sainfoin) honey
items.text: Known as "white honey". Creamy and naturally crystallised, with an elegant flavour that pairs with yogurt, bread, cheese and wine.

items.name: Sbiten
items.text: A traditional Russian honey-and-spice syrup with Siberian fir extract, with ginger or with sage. Stir a spoonful into hot water, tea or mulled wine.

categories.quote: My mother's family has been making honey for seventy years. My grandfather cared for the bees all year round and never left his small Siberian village.

categories.title: Ivan-chai & Russian herbal teas
text: Ivan-chai is made from the fermented leaves and flowers of fireweed. Exported to Europe in the days of the Russian Empire, it is a tea with a long story — and it is naturally caffeine-free, so it can be enjoyed at any time of day, by the whole family.

items.name: Ivan-chai with sea buckthorn
items.text: A favourite of northern Russia, with bright, tangy sea buckthorn.

items.name: Ivan-chai with oregano, mint or thyme
items.text: Classic herbal blends — warming oregano, calming mint, fragrant thyme.

items.name: Ivan-chai with rose hip or blackcurrant leaf
items.text: Hot in winter, iced in summer.

items.name: Ivan-chai with ginger and lemon
items.text: A Siberian winter staple.

items.name: Chaga tea with thyme or mint
items.text: Made from chaga, a birch mushroom that grows slowly over ten to fifteen years.

categories.quote: I grew up surrounded by the beautiful nature of northern Russia, picking berries and herbs to brew. In distant Siberia I found the taste of my childhood — and I want to share it with you.

categories.title: Siberian pine nut foods
text: Seeds of the Siberian pine, which grows wild across Siberia, naturally contain unsaturated fatty acids such as pinolenic, oleic and linoleic acid, along with dietary fibre, B vitamins and minerals.

items.name: Pine nut oil
items.text: Cold-pressed and unfiltered. Best enjoyed unheated — drizzled on dishes or in dressings.

items.name: Pine nut cake
items.text: What remains after pressing the oil, rich in protein. Eat like nuts, with honey and yogurt, or in cooking.

items.name: Pine cone jam
items.text: A Siberian speciality made from young pine cones, sugar and natural lemon juice.

categories.title: Chocolate with freeze-dried Siberian fruit
text: Delicious, pretty chocolate topped generously with freeze-dried Siberian fruit — free of additives, flavourings and colourings. A popular gift.

items.name: Milk chocolate with pine nuts and lingonberry
items.text: With freeze-dried lingonberry and Siberian pine nuts. Made without preservatives — best enjoyed soon after purchase.

categories.title: Uvelka Russian buckwheat
text: In Russia and Eastern Europe, buckwheat is eaten as whole groats rather than flour or noodles — a wholesome everyday staple, loved by dancers and athletes alike.

items.name: Uvelka buckwheat groats
items.text: Whole buckwheat from Russia.

categories.title: Vintage Shar glass ornaments
text: Founded in Veliky Novgorod in 2011, the Vintage Shar workshop supplies the Russian and European markets. Every ornament — from blowing the glass to painting each design — is made entirely by hand, without stickers or prints.

items.name: Hand-painted glass ornaments
items.text: Winter scenes, St Petersburg, the Nutcracker, angels, birds, a squirrel with mushrooms and many more.

categories.title: Matryoshka, folk crafts & goods
text: Hand-painted matryoshka, roly-poly dolls and accessories with the warmth that only handwork has. As each piece is handmade, sizes may vary slightly.

items.name: Hand-painted matryoshka
items.text: Original works including "A Story of One Day", "Angel and the Magic Bird" and "Zaznobushka".

items.name: Roly-poly dolls (with bell)
items.text: A traditional toy loved in Russia from royal courts to family homes.

items.name: OXIOMA handmade brooches
items.text: Bronze with gold finish — the Golubushka series.

items.name: Matryoshka tote bags & key rings
items.text: Including our Mount Fuji and lucky-cat matryoshka key rings — a nod to the matryoshka's roots in Japanese nesting dolls.

categories.title: Matryoshka paint sets
text: Make your own matryoshka at home. Outlines are pre-printed, so even first-timers get beautiful results — the same sets we use in our classes.

items.name: Orthodox paint set

privacy.heading: Privacy policy
intro: Global Wish Co., Ltd. ("we") protects the personal information entrusted to us by our customers and strives to provide even greater trust and peace of mind in all our business activities.
We comply with laws and regulations concerning personal information and handle it appropriately.

sections.title: 1. Acquisition of personal information
body: We acquire personal information by lawful and fair means, never by deception or other improper means.

sections.title: 2. Use of personal information
body: We use personal information only to the extent necessary for the purposes below. Should we wish to use it for any other purpose, we will first obtain your consent.
list: Replying to requests for estimates and enquiries, and sending materials
Providing information on exhibitions, products and services

sections.title: 3. Security
body: We take necessary and appropriate measures to prevent leakage, loss or damage of personal information and otherwise keep it secure.

sections.title: 4. Outsourcing
body: When we entrust all or part of the handling of personal information to a third party, we carefully vet that party and supervise it appropriately to ensure the information is kept secure.

sections.title: 5. Provision to third parties
body: We do not disclose or provide your personal information to third parties except in the following cases:
list: When necessary to protect a person's life, body or property and it is difficult to obtain consent
When especially necessary to improve public health or promote the healthy development of children and it is difficult to obtain consent
When necessary to cooperate with a national or local government body, or its contractor, in carrying out duties prescribed by law, and obtaining consent could hinder those duties

sections.title: 6. Disclosure and correction
body: If you request disclosure of your personal information, we will disclose it promptly. If the information is incorrect and you request correction, addition or deletion, we will investigate and respond promptly. We cannot respond if we are unable to confirm your identity.

sections.title: 7. This website
body: This website does not use cookies, analytics or advertising trackers. The contact form does not send or store data on our server: it opens your own email app. Web fonts are loaded from Google Fonts, which receives your IP address as part of normal web requests.
